ai.title: Stateful Agentic Engineering Copilots with Letta: Core Memory, Shared State, Semantic Retrieval, Custom Tools, Streaming, and Portable Agent Workflows
ai.brief: In this tutorial, we build a stateful engineering copilot with Letta that demonstrates how agentic memory extends beyond conventional prompt-based conversations. We begin by creating inspectable core memory blocks that the agent can autonomously update, then expose those blocks for programmatic state synchronization and shared access across multiple agents. af export for portability. sec.title: U.S. CISA adds Collabora Online flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
sec.brief: S. S. S. 2), to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog . Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server is an app for Nextcloud that lets you open, edit and collaborate on documents, spreadsheets and presentations directly in your browser, without needing Microsoft Office installed on your computer. It is based on Collabora Online and LibreOffice technology. 303. Unauthenticated attackers can execute commands when the built-in server is stopped. Standalone Collabora servers are not affected.
